name: Apex
_about: A needle dash in a mid-engine supercar style, generated by tools/gen_apex.py (edit that and regenerate): one cdash layer draws the carbon backdrop with red-glow side panels, the rev counter (0..8, lit white to the revs, amber from 6500 and red from 7000 rpm, a red needle), the line bars and rules. Gear in the middle, speed in the open quarter, boost and oil temperature left, a G-meter right, coolant and fuel along the bottom. No map window. Full screen: the theme's own clock, range and outside temperature in the strip, BMW's gear letter left uncovered.
